headline: Get Popapus
title: How to Get Popapus | The Bubble Gambler | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Popapus is a Water damage dealer from the Whisperwake Isles. Find it in Crescent Bay, where it floats around with colored bubbles. Its Gachapon trait fires random bubbles with every attack. Get five of the same color, or one gold bubble, and a ten second Jackpot starts. Popapus then evolves into Gachapus, its final form. Are you feeling lucky? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Popapus is a Water damage dealer found in Crescent Bay. Its Gachapon trait triggers a 10 second Jackpot with five matching bubbles or a gold bubble. It evolves into Gachapus.
